operatorRequirement: All Jagdlatein knowledge must be correct and checked against multiple independent appropriate sources.

reviewedScope.wildYear: 8 ungulates, 86 biological phases, 96 complete month views; claim-specific sources and explicit differences between sources.
reviewedScope.detailAtlas: 5 comparisons, 15 biological claims, documented real specimens and limits of photograph-based inference.
reviewedScope.dogVideos: 4 licensed documentary clips, visible events separated from interpretation, qualified training and breed sources.
reviewedScope.venisonCuts: 5 cuts correctly located on one documented roe deer photograph; source-scoped cooking and hygiene information.
reviewedScope.smallRevierLife: 6 profiles, original teaching summaries with independent ecology sources; 6 real licensed photos.
reviewedScope.research: DWD annual values, BOKU yearly wildfire counts, BAFU/Swiss Bird Index changes checked against the original data. Methodology sources are not represented as independent duplicate measurements.
reviewedScope.shortRepetition: Reuses maintained DACH course questions, excludes regional law. Retrieval-practice research supports general methods, not the specific app interval schedule.
reviewedScope.relatedExistingContent: 22 explicit aspects in 8 wildlife profiles, 15 lessons in 3 dog courses, 5 nature sections, and source-scoped safety/hygiene sections. Claim limits remain explicit.

confirmedCorrections.issue: German VSG 4.4 unloading provision for vehicles was classified for all DACH countries.
confirmedCorrections.change: Classified for Germany only and excluded from shared DACH repetition.

confirmedCorrections.issue: Absolute rule that a zero always requires a performed survey overlooked prescribed program conventions.
confirmedCorrections.change: Scoped to the learner's own observation records; program-specific definitions explicitly acknowledged in the lesson and question explanation.

limitations: This record is not a complete new factual review of all legacy lessons, questions, species portraits, glossary entries or the e-book.
Structural tests and different source hostnames do not prove factual correctness or source independence.
Existing recorded review dates were not automatically renewed.
Real photos do not independently prove animal age, sex, health, season, successful work or food hygiene unless the cited evidence supports that inference.
